summary: Daily aggregation for Keeping Up with Silicon Valley (induscore.site/sv): Claude Code collects startup/funding/launch/VC stories from ~50 sources (news, essays, YouTube, Reddit; 小红书 and X optional with your own login) and App Store chart movers, curates the edition, persists it to the VM database through the site's ingest API, verifies it is live, and proposes up to 3 movers (publishing those scoring 45 or more). Runs every morning at 07:00 India time from whichever machine is up (scripts/install-schedule.sh). Also records founders' research runs on the private Research page. Say /aggregate-silicon-valley [YYYY-MM-DD].
setup: One-time: get your own ingest token into ~/.config/keeping-up-sv/ingest.env (the command is in SKILL.md, 'One-time setup'), then run `python3 -I ~/.claude/skills/aggregate-silicon-valley/scripts/ingest.py --check`.
